answer: Sybil resistance arises because reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life: an identity must provide sustained, honestly reciprocated service to retain EigenTrust weight. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, lacks trusted inbound paths, and therefore cannot pass consensus; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap it from a grove of colluders that wander between aliases or harbor mutual endorsements.
